questions.question: In which regions of India is the equable climate characterised by very little difference between summer and winter temperatures commonly found?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Western and eastern coast) है।

questions.question: As of March 31, 2024, how many unorganised workers have registered on the eShram portal and been assigned Universal Account Numbers (UAN)?

Article 280 of the Indian Constitution is related to which of the following constitutional bodies?
The Hunsgi Paleolithic site is located in which Indian state?
Which of the following is a local festival of Chhattisgarh?
निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा, भाषण और अभिव्यक्ति की स्वतंत्रता के अधिकार पर युक्तियुक्त प्रतिबंध है?
options: किसी कानून के विरुद्ध शांतिपूर्ण तरीके से विरोध प्रदर्शन
हिंसा भड़काने वाली सामग्री प्रकाशित करना
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (हिंसा भड़काने वाली सामग्री प्रकाशित करना) है।
